title: BMX
description:
BMX bikes with lean-driven handling. Two wheels, a real tyre model, and steering that is an OUTPUT of how far you are leaning rather than a key you press -- which is what makes a bike feel like a bike instead of a car with two wheels hidden.

Wheelies, stoppies, manuals, bunny hops, air control and flips. Hold RMB to shift your weight back: RMB + W is a wheelie under power, because that is how a wheelie actually works. Grabbing the front brake shifts your weight forward on its own, whether you meant it or not, which is what makes a stoppie something you can hold.

Raycast wheels and a slip-velocity tyre model, both forces clamped to a friction circle, so a bike that is braking has less grip left for cornering. Lean too far for your speed and the front washes out, because the tyre says so and not because a script decided you should crash.

No content dependencies: base Garry's Mod only, nothing to mount, nothing ripped from another game. Server-authoritative.

  bmx_spawn       spawn a bike (or find BMX in the Entities tab)
  bmx_debug 1     live telemetry overlay
  bmx_selftest    check the physics assumptions on this build

MIT licensed.
